title: Pierre Robiglio
text:
I am an Economist at the Chief Economist Team of DG COMP, European Commission. I hold a PhD in Economics (Cum Laude) from the Rome Economics Doctorate (RED), a program jointly run by EIEF, LUISS, Sapienza University of Rome and Tor Vergata University of Rome.


My research interests are Labor Economics and Industrial Organization. My JMP, co-authored with Edoardo Scalcione, lies at the intersection of these two fields; we use administrative data to study the labor implications of a collusive scheme in the Portuguese labor market.


My PhD supervisors were Matteo Paradisi and Emilio Calvano.

19/07/2025 - I thank the Chief Economist Team at DG COMP for allowing me to present our work on cartels in the labor market during their weekly meeting!.
01/06/2025 - Officially started my PhD traineeship at the Merger Unit of the Chief Economist Team at DG COMP.
27/05/2025 - First presentation of our work on no-poaching agreements in front of the always active EIEF audience.
